title: A Ember for the Oath Revisited
author: Rafael Halloran
blurb: Zephyrine Winterbourne, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
